title: Hearty Kenyan Chicken Biryani
description: A winey, fluffy, and light Kenyan dish featuring biryani masala, this recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner, served in a bento-box for a unique presentation. It is kosher-friendly and made with stir-fry techniques.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is lightly browned.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken breast pieces and cook until they are browned and cooked through.
Add the biryani masala and stir to combine.
Add the basmati rice and stir to combine with the chicken and onion mixture.
Add the water and salt, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes or until the rice is cooked and the liquid is absorbed.
